text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Interstitial Cystitis/Bladder Pain Syndrome

The symptoms of chronic suprapubic pain relieved by voiding, nocturia, dyspareunia, and minimal response to NSAIDs are classic for Interstitial Cystitis. While I have requested a Urinalysis and Ultrasound to rule out infection or structural causes, the clinical picture strongly points to this diagnosis. Have you noticed any visible blood in your urine (hematuria) or symptoms that worsen immediately after sexual intercourse?
